title: POV: You Wake Up in Angkor — The Hydraulic Metropolis of the Khmer Empire #shorts
hook_text: THIS CITY MANAGED WATER ON A MASSIVE SCALE
description:
Step into Angkor, reconstructed as a cinematic historical short using archaeological evidence and cautious interpretation. Some details remain debated or uncertain.
